Unit test setup for topology config, workspace creation, and tile initialization.

# Purpose
This file defines support code for tile unit tests in the Firedancer topology system. It builds a test environment around a selected `fd_topo_run_tile_t` by loading topology configuration files, initializing the `config_t` object, and preparing the topology data needed by the tile under test. The file also declares a set of external object callback tables in `CALLBACKS[]` and a set of dummy tiles in `TILES[]` so the test topology can be filled with the tile names and object handlers expected by both `fdctl` and Firedancer topologies.

The main entry point is `fd_tile_unit_test_init()`. This function reads the default, override, and user topology config files, calls `fd_config_load()`, runs the topology initialization callback, and then finds the tile that matches the requested tile name. For each workspace used by that tile, it creates an anonymous workspace with `fd_wksp_new_anon()`, allocates the required topology footprint, and registers the workspace with `fd_topo_wksp_new()`. After the required workspaces are ready, it fills the tile record with `fd_topo_fill_tile()` and returns the initialized `fd_topo_tile_t` pointer for the unit test.
